import sys

def main() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().splitlines()
    # handle possible empty lines
    arr1 = list(map(int, data[0].split())) if len(data) > 0 else []
    arr2 = list(map(int, data[1].split())) if len(data) > 1 else []
    n = len(arr1)
    if n != len(arr2):
        print("false")
        return
    stack = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < n:
        stack.append(arr1[i])
        i += 1
        while stack and stack[-1] == arr2[j]:
            stack.pop()
            j += 1
    print("true" if j == n and not stack else "false")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
